One Balance,Many Markets

Shared liquidity on Sui. One wallet balance backs swaps, payments, limit orders and markets at the same time, and your coins stay in your wallet until a trade settles.

Built on Sui Sui Allowances Address balances One-PTB settlement
01
The problem

Every market wants its own deposit

A market maker who wants to quote on an AMM, a limit book, an RFQ desk and a payment rail has to split capital four ways and lock each part in someone else's vault.

AMM poolDeposit into the pool
250,000 tJPY
Limit ordersEscrowed per order
250,000 tJPY
RFQ deskPre-funded inventory
250,000 tJPY
PaymentsSettlement float
250,000 tJPY
¼ of the capital is available to any single market. The rest sits idle, and all of it is in custody.
02
The idea

Grant a permission, not a deposit

Your wallet 1,000,000 tJPY

A Sui Allowance lets Suijin pull up to a cap, until an expiry, only through Suijin's contract. Revoke it any time.

03
How a trade settles

Four steps, one PTB

1Grant an Allowance

Capped, expiring, revocable, spendable only through Suijin. Nothing moves.

propose_for_app
2Open markets

Fixed price, curve or limit order, each drawing on the same budget.

create_fixed · create_curve
3Best route wins

Quotes read every budget fresh from a fullnode, so the price shown is the price Move recomputes.

POST /v1/quote
4Settle atomically

Two Allowance withdrawals in one PTB. Every check passes, or nothing moves.

settlement::fill
04
What you can do

Four products, one balance

⇅Swap

Best price across every market, exact in or exact out.

→Pay

Pay a merchant exactly what they asked, in their token, from yours. Minimum enforced on-chain.

◷Limit

Sell at your price and wait. Coins stay in your wallet; partial fills allowed.

✦Earn

Two-sided liquidity from your wallet: fixed or curve, your fee, your expiry.

Any Sui coin: SUI USDC DEEP tUSD tJPY or paste any coin type
05
Why only on Sui

Built from Sui primitives

CoreApp-bound Allowances

The spend permit is minted only by suijin::app. The executor cannot spend it any other way.

CustodyAddress balances

Coins stay plain wallet balances. Settlement delivers with balance::send_funds.

AtomicityPTBs

One fill withdraws from two allowances and pays both sides in a single transaction.

AccessShared objects

Markets, orders and allowances are shared, so any fill can be settled.

MetadataCoin Registry

Symbols, decimals and icons for any coin, read on-chain.

ReadsgRPC + GraphQL

GraphQL to discover, gRPC to price, so quotes match what Move recomputes.

06
Security model

The executor picks when, never what

The executor can

  • Delay or skip an orderTraders' approvals expire in 5 minutes
  • Choose which fill goes firstEach order fills at most once

The executor cannot

  • Change a price or amountMove recomputes the output and checks both withdrawals exactly
  • Change who gets paidRecipients are fixed in the market and the order
  • Go past a cap, an expiry or a real balanceThe Sui framework enforces the Allowance
  • Keep your fundsProviders revoke any time; nothing is deposited
